name: Introduce a Generation to Engineering Day (IGED)
org: Argonne National Laboratory (Women in Science and Technology)
what_you_do: A one-day event at Argonne for 8th graders. You hear talks from engineers, meet a mentor, and learn what engineering jobs are like.
who_can_apply: Students in 8th grade. Space is limited and students are picked by lottery.
pay_detail: The page does not say if there is a cost.
deadline_text: The 2026 day was Feb 26, 2026, and sign-up closed Jan 23, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application on the event page when it opens. Everyone who applies gets an email saying if they got a spot.
notes: Last year, sign-up closed in late January. Argonne also runs Science Careers in Search of Women for high school girls.
